features.description: Steel base envelope 23.00 by 18.750 by 4.38. Plan origin at outside lower-left corner.
Grouped primary guide/shoulder machining at four corner regions. Multiple sketches required; upper and lower openings differ. Preserve separately controlled surfaces B through N.
Stepped longitudinal slot from right end into pocket. Opening .688 ±.002; inner enlargement 1.25; depths .56 and 1.06; lip offset .28. Confirm lip/profile topology before modeling.
Circular access pocket, diameter 2.00 and depth 1.25, merging with slot.
Twelve .19-radius transitions on called-out guide edges only.

Six blind 5/8-11-2B holes. Four known plan centers: [5.5,3.375], [5.5,7.875], [5.5,10.875], [5.5,15.375]. Other pair at x=6.125 and 11.000 apart; absolute y unconfirmed. Drill .531 to 1.75; thread to 1.25.
Two .562 through holes at x=.438, y=6.25 and 12.5 in plan.
Four left-end 5/8-11-2B holes; drill .531 to 1.75; thread to 1.25. Nonuniform row spacing.
Six right-end 1/2-13-2B holes; drill .422 to 1.31; thread to .94. Excludes the two dowel holes.
Two .501 ±.001 blind dowel holes, .75 deep. Preserve separate ±.001 shoulder-referenced positional dimensions.
Four 1/8-27 NPTF holes, .339 drill to 2.88. Right-view column 1.00 from left edge; repetition on other end regions/faces requires mapping.
Four 1/8-27 NPTF holes, .339 drill to 1.62. Right-view column 2.50 from left edge.
Four 1/8-27 NPTF holes, .339 drill to 3.00. Right-view column 3.56 from left edge.
Five-hole groups at four places, 20 holes total: .203 drill .75 deep, 1/4-20-2B thread .50 deep. Exact face transforms need verification.
Two-hole groups at four places, 8 total: .203 drill .75, 1/4-20-2B thread .50. Front upper-right pair: 1.500 spacing, nearest hole .688 from right end, row 1.000 below top.
Three-hole rows at eight places, 24 total: .203 drill .75, 1/4-20-2B thread .50. Outer span 2.625; middle ordinate 1.312; edge offsets .312. Not exactly equal spacing at printed precision.

Twelve holes at two places, 24 total: .203 drill .75, 1/4-20-2B thread .50. Each visible face has six columns x=4.875,7.875,10.875,12.125,15.125,18.125 and two rows y=.88,2.88 nominal from front-view bottom. Opposite face transform unconfirmed.

warnings: No explicit ASME/ISO/DIN designation is printed. Third-angle projection and inch units are explicit; do not invent a modern governing GD&T standard for this 1975 drawing.
Revision 2 is taken from the latest change entry dated DEC 2,75. Earlier change 1 is AUG 19,75. Original date JAN 29,75. Design control K911.

Dimensions without explicit tolerance fields use the title-block precision-based general tolerances and referenced company specifications. Default zero tolerance fields do not mean exact/no tolerance. Original trailing zeros are retained in notes where consequential.

IE357 steel grade, IE421 hole classes A/B, IE500 thread requirements and IE2122 finish-code definitions are not supplied. Do not convert H/K/N to numerical roughness or assume a generic steel grade. Heat-treatment field appears blank.
Letters A/B after some hole diameter callouts are preserved as printed and are not automatically GD&T datum references. Their meaning requires IE421.
NOTE 1: SURFACES (B) AND (C) TO BE IN LINE AND perpendicular TO (A) .002. NOTE 2: SURFACES (D) AND (E) TO BE parallel (B) AND (C) AND perpendicular (A) .002.
NOTE 3: SURFACES (F)(J)(K) AND (M) TO BE IN LINE WITH EACH OTHER AND parallel (A) .002. NOTE 4: SURFACES (G)(H)(L) AND (N) TO BE IN LINE WITH EACH OTHER AND parallel (A) .002.

Geometric tolerance frames use legacy printed order: perpendicular A B .002 at left length end, perpendicular A C .002 at right end, perpendicular A .002 in left elevation, and two parallel A .002 frames in front elevation. The tool schema cannot attach each frame to an exact edge; preserve these locations.

Corner guide machining F002 and stepped slot F003 require manual profile verification before a build. D035's exact extension-line target and the slot lip offsets are not fully resolved from this scan.

Top six-hole callout H004 has four fully located centers recorded in F006. The 11.000-spaced pair has x=6.125 but unconfirmed absolute y. Conditional symmetric ordinates are explicitly flagged D155/D156; do not silently use them.

Empty instance_positions on repeated multi-face callouts are intentional: all face-local transforms and every instance location could not be confidently resolved. Counts are multiplied literally: 5 holes 4 places=20; 2 holes 4 places=8; 3 holes 8 places=24; 12 holes 2 places=24. Verify no shared/intersecting passage is being double-counted during model construction.

For F017, the twelve readable front-view centers are the Cartesian product of x=[4.875,7.875,10.875,12.125,15.125,18.125] and y=[.88,2.88]. The second 12-hole face requires coordinate transformation, so H013 is not falsely marked fully positioned.

All supplied hole coordinates are local to the named view, edge-referenced from its lower-left outside corner; Left and Right views have different face orientations. They are not interchangeable global XYZ coordinates.

Dowel hole coordinates derived from outside edges are nominal only. Retain the printed ±.001 distances from the indicated shoulder and the separate ±.001 spacing; do not replace them with an accumulated general-tolerance ordinate.

Cross-check: 1.312+1.312=2.624 versus printed 2.625 corner span, a .001 rounding difference. Likewise .312+3.750+.312=4.374 versus 4.38 thickness, .006 difference. Do not force these rounded nominal loops to exact equality.
Cross-check: 1.25-.688=.562; two .28 lip offsets sum to .560. This .002 difference is compatible with rounded callouts but requires preserving printed dimensions, not replacing them.
No REF/parenthesized dimensions identified. Circled 1 and 2 are change markers. No countersink, counterbore, chamfer, or angular dimension is explicitly called out.

Features represent grouped manufacturing operations rather than fully executable single-sketch CAD definitions. Thread specs are included with holes; no uncalled-for chamfers or thread lead-ins have been added.
